title: UPPER & LOWER WINDSHIELD FRAME
summary: Steel windshield frame inside the fiberglass body: the upper header is an inner frame [1] (convertible 19467 uses its own part) spot-welded to an outer frame [2] and to the upper corners, and the lower frame (cowl / windshield base) is an outer frame [3] spot-welded to the inner frame [4] and to the lower corner frames on both sides. Flanges are sealed with sealer-adhesive 86a and plastisol sealer 122a/122c.
